features.label: Indexing and graph freshness
features.description: graph_index runs ensureFresh (incremental unless force), then regenerates briefs, writes unresolved categorization and reports functionality.json anchor validation. ensureFresh resolves a relative repoRoot and forces a full rebuild when the indexed commit cannot be diffed. graphCurrency returns current, stale or unknown; the server warns on read verbs when stale, or unknown with a manifest present, and fresh:true or APG_AUTO_REINDEX reindexes first only when stale.

features.label: Symbol lookup and search
features.description: graph_whereis refuses a limit below 1 and reports shown-of-population counts from one windowed query over declaration types. graph_lookup falls back from exact label to qname, then parent_class, for Class::method or Class.method. graph_search defaults to kind auto, which excludes only External stubs, caps limit at 100, and degrades semantic mode to lexical with a hint when embeddings, an embedder or strong matches are missing.

features.label: Callers and callees from the graph
features.description: graph_callers walks execution-family edges into the target, fetching at most 100 edges (one extra row detects truncation) with the file filter applied in SQL before that cap; the recursive walk's guard stops it at depth 11. rankCallers puts LSP_VERIFIED edges first. graph_callees mirrors this outward. A call outside any function is a caller from its File node. An empty result carries buildAbsenceTrustLine: heuristic, not exhaustive, check with code_intel_references or rg.

features.label: Change impact and consequences
features.description: graph_impact walks impact-family edges backwards (default depth 3, guard stops at 11), dedupes by edge keeping the shortest depth, and adds one hop of OVERRIDDEN_BY edges out of the target. graph_consequences on a symbol or file returns features, contracts, open tasks, tests_adjacent, last_touched and risk_flags (no_test_coverage, orphan_anchor); a task id returns only features, contracts and sibling tasks. findCompanionHeaders finds same-stem indexed headers of .cpp-family files.

features.label: Context packets for a task, feature or symbol
features.description: graph_packet resolves feature:<id> or task:<id>; a bare target is tried as feature id or label, task, then a symbol or file mapped to a feature, else a symbol pointer packet. It lists READ FIRST, CONTRACTS, TESTS and RISKS; feature packets add confirmation state. Without live=true it prints LIVE: skipped_under_budget; live=true runs graph_consequences within 2000 ms and adds LAST TOUCHED and CO-CONSUMER FILES; a feature:<id> target reports LIVE: unavailable.

features.label: Graph health and trust verdict
features.description: graph_health returns indexed:false with trust 'missing' when graph.sqlite is absent. computeTrustLevel maps trust-relevant unresolved edges to weak (>2000), ok (>500) or strong. buildNextActions returns at most 3 steps, code-intel trust-spine problems first. inspectStorage reports the free-page ratio and offers compaction at 50 MB and 25% free. decideStaleRefusal refuses reads when the server runs outdated code, unless the delta has no executable files or APG_ALLOW_STALE_PROCESS=1.

features.label: Document-to-code links
features.description: During indexing, detectDocLinks emits LINKS_TO edges from Documents to file-level nodes: authored Markdown links at 0.95, inline-code paths at 0.85, unique path-suffix matches at 0.8; bare basenames and ambiguous paths are refused. detectDocRefs emits MENTIONS edges to symbols: qualified names in inline code at 0.9, and a bare name heading a code span on a line naming the declaring file's path at 0.85. Prose and fenced blocks are not admitted.

features.label: Live language-server code intel
features.description: code_intel_references and code_intel_hierarchy query a live language server (clangd, typescript-language-server or pyright), choosing the given language, else the file extension, else cpp. getLiveSession keeps one session per language and project root, evicts dead clients and dedupes concurrent starts.
